description: Angular component for managing filter dialogs in the Thingsboard UI, including filter creation, editing, duplication, and validation.

classes.name: FiltersDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for filter management dialog, including filter list handling, validation, duplication, and user interactions.

methods.name: createFilterFormControl
methods.description: Creates a form control for a filter with validation.

methods.name: filtersFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of filters.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a control is in an error state for UI validation.

methods.name: removeFilter
methods.description: Removes a filter from the list, with checks for associated widgets.

methods.name: getNextDuplicatedName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for duplicated filters.

methods.name: duplicateFilter
methods.description: Duplicates an existing filter with a new unique name.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new filter.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing filter.

methods.name: openFilterDialog
methods.description: Handles opening filter dialog for add/edit operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the filters, closing dialog or showing errors.
